split_source: configs/first_experiment/frozen_rows.csv; preserve train_role boundaries as first IF implementation does

pca.combination: max(Q / normal calibration Q95, T2 / normal calibration T2_95)

if.representative: fixed equal-weight mean of per-seed Q95-scaled scores

operation.normalization: score / normal calibration 95th percentile (higher); reject reference <= 1e-12
operation.pca_fallback: one P0 selected using selection only, shared by every P1/P2
operation.if_fallback: same seed I0, ensemble after fallback
operation.threshold: recalibrate on all normal calibration operational scores

selection.primary: none-postprocessing operational candidates; selection FPR<=.01, then Recall desc, F1 desc, AP desc, fit+development score seconds asc, key asc
selection.no_eligible: label target unmet; descriptive fallback minimum FPR then Recall
selection.alternative: maximize F1 over four predeclared calibration target thresholds then Recall, AP, runtime
selection.p0_fallback: same primary rule among P0 only
selection.postprocess: compare none, consecutive2, two_of_three on chosen model, select only development compliant highest Recall then F1; none preferred ties

evaluation.common: all candidate/windows available endpoint intersection, frozen before scoring; also per-window pair intersection
evaluation.denominator_zero: Precision/F1/F2=0 where undefined; class-denominator rates and rank metrics missing for absent classes
evaluation.ranking_score: continuous anomaly score; postprocessing preserves original score for AP/ROC

auxiliary.sensor_subsets: all seven nonempty subsets: raw P0 and burst-aware W10 PCA; k=min(2,rank-1) for Q, rank1 T2 only; development descriptive, not selectable
auxiliary.matched_count: if same-condition P2 or I2 improves common-L selection Recall or F1 at .01: sample P1/I1 train endpoints to aware count, seeds42/43/44; same k/scores
auxiliary.probability: regularized nonnegative-slope sigmoid on standardized log1p operational score; fit calibration normal+anomaly; selection Brier, logloss, reliability; no selection threshold optimization
auxiliary.error_bins: normal train absolute-sensor and within-burst absolute current-difference quartiles; burst positions <window and burst lengths <window
auxiliary.uncertainty: IF seed sample mean/std; no row-iid confidence intervals

final_gate: selection_lock.json required before test scores; no tuning after test
budget: 26 primary PCA decompositions; 21 IF fits; 14 sensor subset decompositions; conditional matched-count up to 72 PCA + 9 IF fits, three random samples; no LSTM retraining
